value.rule: Use complete actual source classAccess for rank/minimum/school/baseRP. All seven are Action,60ft,V/S/F. Base costs Clone/Rebind/Sculptor13; Reversal/Theft7; Seal/Communion10. Real Action, RP, body/hand/focus, repertoire and predeclared fixed choices precede casting. Starting incompatible concentration ends it at commitment; none of these seven itself requires concentration except ordinary Ready's paid hold. Counter windows are at casting/preparation only. Actual class reductions, base strain, Refrain and surcharge are retained; no refund for a legal paid failure. Ordinary Ready fixes spell/mode/inverse/type/IDs then selects legal actual target/effect/area at release under its exact contract. No reaction/extra Action provider is invented.

Real regular START/END identities are distinct from numbered rounds and absolute seconds. Future markers exclude already underway phases where specified. No extra turn, absence, replacement or suppression resets an original marker. Refresh real action wallets only at actual applicable START; same-round owner-wide companion/copy/extra-action history remains. Outside-initiative local deadlines stay fixed on later initiative entry. Expiry/true source end precedes later same-time payload requests. Registered fallback clocks explicitly identified in Rebind supply no turns.

Source and target witnesses belong to real declared bodies/anchors. Distances are actual occupied-boundary separation unless a named source supplies center/emitter convention. A range witness and line-of-effect segment must be consistent. Complete body fit, intervening occupied space, visibility and actual supports are separate predicates. Synthetic fixture geometry is explicitly stated, not a new creature or campaign route. Images are nonphysical: no body/collision/cover/load.

Retain original cast, application, component, creator, dealer and source budgets. A modifier's creator does not inherit an ordinary parent's attacks/healing/kills. New healing-to-damage roots use the actual native producer at the declared checkpoint; original damage transformations retain lineage. No duplicate callbacks reapply effect, pay/refresh twice, or renew inversion/transfer/one-shot entitlements. Explicit new local exceptions never import a generic copying/conversion system.

Complete accepted Antimagic/GreaterDispel input/output, immutable captured operations and self-field exception govern. Distinguish a current suppressed expression from true source ending. Clocks and spent history continue; no missed command or pulse is banked. Temporary suppression never reverses completed HP, movement or costs. Parent-specific body suppression/ending always controls, and a modifier's resumption never recreates an ended parent.

Perception/access precede declared selection; no silent source owner/rank/hostility roster is published. Private draws, application IDs and known-false records are durable internal data, not a sixth Fate channel. Each event's observations are immutable copies of its own after-state. Native and historical source text remain separately complete. Case premises about actors, actual acquired class choices, knowledge, consent, space and provider events are synthetic source-qualified inputs, never proof of campaign acquisition or runtime behavior.
